name: Yuuto
source:
A boy Shou met in a club. He has a cheerful, outgoing, energetic, and friendly personality.

He also likes to draw, so he always has a sketchbook. Everyone wonders if his wish to remain a child forever will come true...

[From [url=http://mintwings.web.fc2.com/m01/character.html]official website[/url]]
